main_text.head: VETVSTISSIMARVM PRIMI MVNDI ANTIQVITATVM SECTIONES, SEV LIBRI IIII.
PROOEMIVM.

head.i: De varijs Mundi, quæ vocantur, ætatibus, & quæ Ætas in hoc opere describatur.

main_text.p: VONIAM nobis propositum est primam ætatem huius conspicui Mundi à Deo cõditi, eiúsque vetustissimæ antiquitatem tùm ex ipsissimis S. Scriptura & limpidissimis fontibus haustas, tùm ex Ethnicorum etiam ipsorum monumentis investigatas, describere, (quæ res cum scitu iucundissima est: tum verò ad veram pietatis agnitionem, id est, tum nostræ damnationis, tum redemptionis causas explicandas, nosq; in fide confirmandos necessaria) primùm in quot ætates, distinctaq; secula tota Mundi huius duꙖrant.
[Note: the body text of this paragraph runs over the page edge at the foot; the final word is cut off.]

page.notes: The woodcut initial "V" (decorated Q-shaped letter) is at the left; the first word is "VONIAM" where "NONIAM" would be expected; the initial letter is a large decorative capital and was read as V. The last line is cut at the right edge and ends with "du-" as a hyphenated word, the continuation "rant." is in the next line of the printed text, which appears partly obscured. A reference mark in the margin (a small leaf/anchor sign) stands at the end of the last line and is not a printed note.
